source.coinbase_policy_chunk: embedded payload chunk 6a (7629 chars), attributed by its own opening sentence naming Coinbase Onchain Bug Bounty Program

findings.upfront_payment: UNKNOWN. The Coinbase policy text contains no deposit/fee wording and the listing card lacks the Deposit required label; this is absence of a statement, not proof of free submission. Platform-level terms were not read.
findings.autonomous_ai_eligibility: UNKNOWN. The Coinbase text does not mention AI, agents or automated tooling. Pendle AI rules are a different program and are not transferred. Unknown permission is not authorization.
findings.identity: UNVERIFIED. The age/residency wording does not establish natural-person-only eligibility. Participant eligibility for this operation has not been verified.
findings.submission: NOT ESTABLISHED. The policy directs reports through Spearbit/Cantina. This quotation does not establish a login requirement; approved submission access and account-specific requirements remain unverified.
findings.settlement: UNKNOWN: payout in USDC per listing; payout KYC/wallet terms for Coinbase not stated in this chunk.
findings.testing: Local-only testing is required; mainnet/testnet testing without authorization is prohibited.

decision: Stop this bounded candidate assessment without speculative testing. Usable participation and submission prerequisites have not been established; AI rules, fees and settlement remain unknown. This is not a verified prohibition or a global revenue blockage.
reconsideration_trigger: Verified program participation eligibility, AI rules, fees, approved submission access and settlement prerequisites establish a usable authorized route. Then define one bounded offline task within the verified program scope.
limits: One saved listing page only; no program page, platform terms or login-gated content read. Rewards are advertised maxima, not funding or revenue.
correction_note: Removed unsupported natural-person-only and authenticated-login inferences; retained observed quotations and uncertainty.
